title: What to do if your smartphone is lost or stolen
desc: Lock down your identity, secure financial accounts, and protect your personal data immediately.
todos: Log into Apple Find My or Google Find My Device from another browser to remotely lock the phone and erase data.
Call your mobile carrier to suspend service and prevent unauthorized calls or SMS 2FA hijacks.
Change passwords for critical accounts starting with primary email, banking, and social media apps.
Unlink digital wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay) and notify your bank to monitor for fraudulent charges.
File a report with local police and note the IMEI number for insurance claims.
